headline: Codelco Reports $7.49 Billion EBITDA and $1.94 Billion Fiscal Transfer to September
summary: State-owned Codelco posted an EBITDA of $7.49 billion in the first nine months of the year—up 80% year-on-year—and raised fiscal contributions to $1.94 billion, while registering an asset write-down of nearly $5 billion.
why: Codelco is the world's largest copper producer, making its financial results and production metrics critical indicators for the global copper market and Chile's public budget.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Higher fiscal contributions from Codelco directly increase state revenues for Chile.
